findings.flicker: Offline, on the v4 raw fills with the finish as shipped: water frames 30-35, the raw fill moves 1.5 EV (p95) on pixels the source holds still, the finished fill 0.115; with the model's detail removed 0.061. The door (09V frames 40-47): raw 0.076, finished 0.013. The flicker is the model's detail jumping on still pixels inside moving highlights.
findings.structure_on_testwindow: Frame 0 has no previous frame, so nothing is averaged there, and its S is 0.010: the model itself draws no fine structure in the glare. The level is right (1.2 x white at the rim rising to 3.3-3.9 at the core, the master flat at 1.2-1.4), there is no step at the rim (fill = master in the first 15 px) and no flicker (0.0145 EV). No render-time setting can add structure the model did not draw.

decision_rule: PASS = every shot passes the gates listed for it and both H checks pass: AI fill v4 (the v4.2 LoRA with this inference) goes into 1.2.4, EXPERIMENTAL and off by default, described as: it sets the level of a bright region and draws detail where the model finds some; in a smooth glare it adds level and no texture. known_limits: Fast-moving specular water: slight flicker in the fill (0.11 EV p95 on still pixels).
